base_recheck.scope_timing: Snapshot after EWT migration, not an upload or authorization to publish unrelated files

publication_rule.permitted: Code, literature/source documentation, aggregate metrics and fit histories, hashes/audits, licensed ScienceDB XLS and CSVs, numeric candidate/structural-control parameter representations.
publication_rule.root_scope_clarification: Project lead explicitly included our own trained candidate/control state_dict numeric JSONs for mechanism/forward verification; these are not upstream author price/volume tables.
publication_rule.excluded: New author datasets without declared redistribution licenses, their per-date quantity exports, point observations/forecast paths, and binary torch checkpoint files.
publication_rule.licensed_exception: ScienceDB DOI10.11922/sciencedb.819 under current official CC BY 4.0 metadata.

limitations: Ignored runtime caches are outside Git-visible public candidates.
Known-hash, filename/extension, CSV-schema and JSON-field review is not a mathematical proof that arbitrary aggregates contain no information.
Later additions require a new snapshot or equivalent final package review.

root_publication_rule: Own trained candidate/control numeric state_dict JSONs are explicitly public; full binary checkpoints, point predictions and newly acquired unlicensed author/Tianjin raw or per-date files remain private. Exact licensed ScienceDB XLS/CSV identities remain public.
limitations: The receipt itself is created after its input snapshot and is not self-hashed.
Git-ignored runtime files are not proposed Git exports; optional export directory/archive is reviewed directly when supplied.
Known hashes and schema checks do not prove that arbitrary encoded data cannot hide in text or image pixels.
Later additions or modifications require another new receipt.
